records.summary: Inspected current main before work. Main b90e600 was advanced by scheduled Cross Analysis, not this run. Its unsigned commit changed only generated_at in sentiment_shift.json; XRP/BTC windows had zero entries and null scores. Exact job logs confirm staging, commit and push. Created fresh-main draft PR #1401 replacing Cross Analysis with read-only artifact-only output and three static regression tests; exact-head CI passed 345 tests plus 8 subtests and fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled. PR records the Pages-refresh tradeoff. Refreshed inventory: 175 open, 165 drafts, 10 ready, 173 main-based, 172 stale and one current-base (#1401). PR #1400 remains draft/unmerged and stale; prior CI passed 366+8, but it is not a trained model. Researched Binance's $6.34B update and corrected the 34-hour target to 2026-11-01T05:33Z; the special 12-hour PoR target was 2026-10-31T07:33Z, but actual execution remains unknown and results are due Nov 2. Added official Ripple-Coinbase RLUSD partnership, Circle Arc, Circle-Ripple USDC-on-XRPL partnership and SEC Q2/Q3 filings. Coinbase renewed its Circle arrangement on the same terms while adding RLUSD, supporting a multi-stablecoin strategy rather than simple replacement. No XRP forecast issued and no market feature admitted.
